```{r data, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# the data set is built with model-behavior/makeData.R and added to the package at releases
if (!exists("modelHistory") &&
    !"modelHistory" %in% utils::data(package = "EcoPhyloSim")$results[, "Item"]) {
  cat("The data set `modelHistory` is not available in this installation; it is",
      "built with `model-behavior/makeData.R` of the package repository.\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)
if (!exists("modelHistory")) data("modelHistory", package = "EcoPhyloSim")
s <- modelHistory$summary
ch <- modelHistory$changes
ch <- ch[order(is.na(ch$date), ch$date), ] # planned release last
rel <- ch[ch$kind == "release", ]
runs <- unique(paste(s$version, s$commit))
params <- setdiff(names(s), c("version", "commit", "setting", "generations", "indicator", "mean", "sd", "n"))
typeCol <- c(N = "grey55", B = "#D55E00", S = "#0072B2", "S+B" = "#CC79A7")
# release that a run belongs to: the first release with a version number >= that of the run
releaseOf <- function(run) {
  v <- numeric_version(sub(" .*", "", run))
  rel$version[which(numeric_version(rel$version) >= v)[1]]
}
# observations on the behavior of a release (problems of the code are issues)
notes <- list("0.3.1" = c(
  "Run with `data-raw/packageBehavior.R` (before `model-behavior/run.R` existed) at the pre-release commit 852c61e, i.e. before #173 (only odd grid widths) and #174 (polytomies were still resolved at random, which changes the Colless index per seed); 50,000 generations (100,000 in the density block, 200,000 in the neutral block).",
  "Neutral model: richness up to about 15% above the Ewens sampling formula (batch speciation, #124); Colless index and gamma statistic positive.",
  "Density dependence is weak: richness increases only from about 20 to 25 species and levels off from `density = 0.25`–`0.5`; the competition traits split into two groups at the ends of their range (#133).",
  "The model is neutral if environment and density are both > 0 and their sum is ≤ 1 (#144).",
  "Environmental filtering with global dispersal stays weak (correlation of trait and environment 0.24 at `environment = 1`); with local dispersal, traits match the environment almost perfectly.",
  "A Red Queen advantage of 0.01 with strength 100 more than doubles richness and reduces the mean species age from about 400 to 20 generations."))
```


<div class="abstract">
**Abstract.** The model code of EcoPhyloSim has changed between releases, through
new options, bug fixes and redesigns. This vignette records, for each release,
which changes of the code alter simulation results and how. Each release is run
with the same design (one or two parameters varied around a reference setting,
30 replicates per setting), and indicators of diversity, spatial structure,
traits and phylogeny are compared between releases. Single changes between
releases are tested one by one to attribute the differences to them. Use it to
check whether results obtained with an earlier release still hold, and to
understand why they may differ. The main vignette ("The EcoPhyloSim R Package",
`vignette("PhyloSimManual", package = "EcoPhyloSim")`) describes the current model.

**Status.** Runs of the design so far: `r paste(runs, collapse = ", ")` (release
and commit). The comparisons between releases fill in as runs of further releases
are added.
</div>

# Releases at a glance

```{r timeline, fig.height = 3, fig.cap = "Releases (diamonds; open: planned) and the changes of the model code that alter simulation results, in their order (not to scale in time)."}
op <- par(mar = c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5))
n <- nrow(ch)
isRel <- ch$kind == "release"
plot(NA, xlim = c(0.5, n + 0.5), ylim = c(-0.9, 2.6), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
segments(1, 0, n, 0, col = "grey40", lwd = 2)
k <- which(!isRel)
segments(k, 0, k, 0.35, col = "grey70")
points(k, rep(0.35, length(k)), pch = 21, cex = 1.8, bg = typeCol[ch$type[k]], col = "white")
text(k, 0.6, sub("^branch | [(].*", "", ch$reference[k]), srt = 60, adj = 0, cex = 0.7, col = "grey20")
k <- which(isRel)
points(k, rep(0, length(k)), pch = 23, cex = 3, bg = ifelse(is.na(ch$date[k]), "white", "black"))
text(k, -0.45, ch$version[k], font = 2)
text(k, -0.8, ifelse(is.na(ch$date[k]), "planned", format(ch$date[k], "%Y")), cex = 0.8, col = "grey30")
legend("topright", legend = names(typeCol), pt.bg = typeCol, pch = 21, col = "white", pt.cex = 1.6,
       horiz = TRUE, bty = "n", cex = 0.8, title = "Type")
par(op)
```

Types of changes: **N** (numeric): results for a given seed change, their
distributions do not; **B** (behavior): patterns change; **S** (semantics):
parameters are renamed or redefined, so that the same call means a different
model; **S+B**: both.

```{r overview}
count <- function(v) {
  t <- table(factor(ch$type[ch$kind == "change" & ch$version == v], names(typeCol)))
  t <- t[t > 0]
  if (!length(t)) "none" else paste(t, names(t), collapse = ", ")
}
tab <- data.frame(Release = rel$version,
                  Date = ifelse(is.na(rel$date), "planned", format(rel$date)),
                  Commit = rel$commit,
                  "Changes of results" = vapply(rel$version, count, ""),
                  "Run of the design" = vapply(rel$version, function(v)
                    if (v %in% s$version) paste("at commit", s$commit[s$version == v][1]) else "not yet", ""),
                  check.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(tab[nrow(tab):1, ], row.names = FALSE)
```

# Patterns across releases

The figure shows key indicators for nine key settings (50 × 50 cells,
`specRate = 2`, other parameters at their defaults unless stated), the patterns
of the chapter "Emerging patterns" of the package vignette. `r if (length(runs) > 1)
"Intervals of two releases that do not overlap indicate a change; the tests in the next section give the significance." else
paste("So far it shows only the run of", runs, "for reference; the comparison follows with the runs of further releases.")`

```{r keys}
key <- list(
  "Neutral, global dispersal" = list(block = "neutral", x = 50, specRate = 2),
  "Neutral, dispersal 1 (reference)" = list(block = "dispersal", dispersal = "1"),
  "Environment 1, global" = list(block = "environment", dispersal = "global", environment = 1),
  "Environment 1, dispersal 1" = list(block = "environment", dispersal = "1", environment = 1),
  "Density 1, dispersal 1" = list(block = "density", density = 1, densityCut = 1),
  "Environment 0.5 + density 0.5" = list(block = "envDensity", environment = 0.5, density = 0.5),
  "Environment 1 + density 1" = list(block = "assembly", dispersal = "1", environment = 1, density = 1),
  "Protracted 1" = list(block = "speciation", protracted = 1, redQueen = 0),
  "Red Queen 0.01 (strength 100)" = list(block = "speciation", redQueen = 0.01))
indicators <- c(richness = "Richness", conspecificNeighbors = "Conspecific neighbors",
                corTraitEnv = "Cor(trait, environment)", sdCompetitionTrait = "SD competition trait",
                colless = "Colless index", gamma = "Gamma statistic",
                meanSpeciesAge = "Mean species age", cndd = "CNDD (mortality)")
stat <- function(d, k, i) {
  d <- d[d$indicator == i, ]
  for (p in names(k)) if (p %in% names(d)) d <- d[d[[p]] == k[[p]], ]
  if (nrow(d) != 1) return(c(NA, NA))
  c(d$mean, qt(0.975, pmax(d$n - 1, 1)) * d$sd / sqrt(d$n))
}
```

```{r patterns, fig.height = 8, fig.cap = "Replicate means with 95% confidence intervals at the last census (CNDD: over the last five generations), per release."}
byRun <- split(s, paste(s$version, s$commit))[runs]
vcol <- setNames(hcl.colors(max(3, length(runs)), "Dark 3")[seq_along(runs)], runs)
op <- par(mfrow = c(4, 2), mar = c(2.5, 0.5, 1.8, 0.5), oma = c(2, 13, 0, 0), cex = 0.7)
yy <- rev(seq_along(key))
for (j in seq_along(indicators)) {
  i <- names(indicators)[j]
  m <- lapply(byRun, function(d) t(sapply(key, stat, d = d, i = i)))
  rng <- range(unlist(lapply(m, function(x) c(x[, 1] - x[, 2], x[, 1] + x[, 2]))), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(NA, xlim = rng, ylim = c(0.5, length(key) + 0.5), yaxt = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "",
       main = indicators[j], font.main = 1)
  abline(h = yy, col = "grey92")
  if (j %% 2 == 1) axis(2, at = yy, labels = names(key), las = 1, outer = TRUE, tick = FALSE)
  off <- if (length(runs) > 1) seq(0.2, -0.2, length.out = length(runs)) else 0
  for (v in seq_along(m)) {
    segments(m[[v]][, 1] - m[[v]][, 2], yy + off[v], m[[v]][, 1] + m[[v]][, 2], yy + off[v], col = vcol[v])
    points(m[[v]][, 1], yy + off[v], pch = 19, col = vcol[v])
  }
}
par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = TRUE)
plot.new()
legend("bottom", legend = runs, col = vcol, pch = 19, horiz = TRUE, bty = "n")
par(op)
```

# Releases in detail

For each release, newest first: the changes of the model code since the previous
release that change simulation results, with their effect on the outputs and the
evidence; the differences measured between the runs of the design; and notes on
the behavior. Each change is compared with its parent commit in two stages:
stage 1 runs the whole design briefly (2 replicates, 300 generations) with the
same seeds and shows whether the results are identical; stage 2 runs the blocks
that differ with 30 replicates and tests whether their distributions differ.
Measured differences are settings where the replicate means of two consecutive
runs differ significantly (Welch test from mean, sd and number of replicates,
Holm correction over all comparisons of the pair, p < 0.05; runtime not tested);
d is the difference (newer minus older) in units of the pooled standard deviation.

```{r detail, results = "asis"}
compareRuns <- function(o, w) {
  o <- o[o$indicator != "runtime", ]
  # a parameter of only one run: keep only its most frequent value there (the default)
  p <- params[vapply(params, function(x) any(!is.na(o[[x]])) && any(!is.na(w[[x]])), logical(1))]
  for (x in setdiff(params, p)) {
    if (any(!is.na(o[[x]]))) o <- o[o[[x]] %in% names(which.max(table(o[[x]]))), ]
    if (any(!is.na(w[[x]]))) w <- w[w[[x]] %in% names(which.max(table(w[[x]]))), ]
  }
  k <- function(d) do.call(paste, c(lapply(d[c(p, "indicator")], as.character), sep = "|"))
  m <- merge(cbind(key = k(o), o), cbind(key = k(w), w[c("mean", "sd", "n")]), by = "key",
             suffixes = c(".old", ".new"))
  se2 <- m$sd.old^2 / m$n.old + m$sd.new^2 / m$n.new
  df <- se2^2 / ((m$sd.old^2 / m$n.old)^2 / (m$n.old - 1) + (m$sd.new^2 / m$n.new)^2 / (m$n.new - 1))
  m$p.adj <- p.adjust(2 * pt(-abs(m$mean.new - m$mean.old) / sqrt(se2), df), "holm")
  m$d <- (m$mean.new - m$mean.old) / sqrt((m$sd.old^2 + m$sd.new^2) / 2)
  sig <- m[!is.na(m$p.adj) & m$p.adj < 0.05, ]
  cat(nrow(sig), " of ", nrow(m), " comparisons significant.

", sep = "")
  shown <- unique(c("block", p[vapply(sig[p], function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1, logical(1))]))
  if (nrow(sig)) print(knitr::kable(sig[c(shown, "indicator", "mean.old", "mean.new", "d", "p.adj")],
                                    digits = 3, row.names = FALSE))
}
for (v in rev(rel$version)) {
  r <- rel[rel$version == v, ]
  cat("
## ", v, if (is.na(r$date)) " (planned)" else paste0(" (", format(r$date), ")"), "

", sep = "")
  d <- ch[ch$kind == "change" & ch$version == v, ]
  cat("**Changes of the model code.** ")
  if (!nrow(d)) cat("First release in this record.

") else {
    cat("

")
    d$change <- paste0(d$change, " (", d$commit, ", ", d$reference, ")")
    print(knitr::kable(d[c("type", "change", "outputs", "evidence")], row.names = FALSE,
                       col.names = c("Type", "Change of the model", "Effect on the outputs", "Evidence")))
  }
  j <- which(vapply(runs, releaseOf, "") == v)
  cat("

**Measured differences.** ")
  if (!length(j)) cat("No run of the design yet.

") else for (jj in j) {
    if (jj == 1) cat("Run ", runs[jj], ": no earlier run to compare with.

", sep = "") else {
      cat("Run ", runs[jj - 1], " → ", runs[jj], ": ", sep = "")
      compareRuns(byRun[[jj - 1]], byRun[[jj]])
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(notes[[v]])) cat("

**Notes.**

", paste("-", notes[[v]], collapse = "
"), "

", sep = "")
}
```

# Using the data

The results are in the data set `modelHistory` (see `?modelHistory`):

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
data(modelHistory)
s <- modelHistory$summary
# richness at the last census in the neutral model with global dispersal, per release
s[s$block == "neutral" & s$x == 50 & s$specRate == 2 & s$indicator == "richness",
  c("version", "mean", "sd", "n")]
```

# Design and indicators

```{r design}
d <- unique(s[c("version", "block", "setting", "generations", params[params != "block"])])
d <- d[d$version == tail(s$version, 1), ]
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$block), function(b) {
  varied <- params[params != "block"][vapply(b[params[params != "block"]], function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1, logical(1))]
  data.frame(Block = b$block[1], Settings = nrow(b),
             Varied = paste(vapply(varied, function(p) paste0(p, " (", paste(sort(unique(b[[p]])), collapse = ", "), ")"), ""),
                            collapse = "; "),
             Generations = format(max(b$generations), big.mark = ","))
})), row.names = FALSE, caption = "Blocks of the design in the newest run: parameters varied around the reference setting (50 × 50 cells, local dispersal 1, specRate = 2, no environmental filtering or density dependence; parameter names of release 0.3.1).")
```

| Indicator | Definition |
|---|---|
| Richness, Shannon, evenness, dominance | number of species; Shannon index; Shannon index / log(richness); share of the most abundant species (evenness and dominance: runs made with `model-behavior/run.R`) |
| Conspecific neighbors | share of the four neighbors of a cell with the same species |
| Cor(trait, environment) | correlation of the environmental trait and the environment over all cells |
| SD competition trait, SD neutral trait | standard deviation of the traits over all cells (neutral trait: runs made with `model-behavior/run.R`) |
| Colless index, gamma statistic, tree height | of the phylogeny of the extant species (Colless index normalized against the Yule model) |
| Mean species age, cor(age, abundance) | age of a species from its ID (IDs are counted up at each speciation); Spearman correlation with abundance |
| CNDD (mortality) | logistic regression of death on the number of conspecifics within radius 2 over the last five generations, with a species effect |
| MPD of local plots | mean p-value of the mean phylogenetic distance of 20 plots of 10 × 10 cells against random communities (runs made with `model-behavior/run.R`); such p-values depend on the plot size and the null model |
| Runtime | of the core simulation, in seconds (machine-dependent, not tested) |

# Reproducing the data

The simulations are run with the scripts in the folder `model-behavior` of the
package repository (<https://github.com/TheoreticalEcology/EcoPhyloSim>), which
also documents every step (`model-behavior/README.md`). In short, from the
repository root:

```{bash, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
# current version (installed in the default library)
Rscript model-behavior/run.R main 12 current ../cache-current
# an older release: install it and the archived dependencies into own libraries
Rscript model-behavior/installOldDeps.R ../lib-olddeps
Rscript model-behavior/installVersion.R v0.3 ../lib-v0.3 ../lib-olddeps
Rscript model-behavior/run.R main 12 0.3 ../cache-v0.3 "lib=../lib-v0.3;../lib-olddeps" commit=v0.3
# per-replicate archive, export of the last census, and this data set
Rscript model-behavior/archive.R ../cache-current ../EcoPhyloSim-runs <version> <commit>
Rscript model-behavior/addRun.R ../EcoPhyloSim-runs/<version>_<commit>
Rscript model-behavior/makeData.R
```

Each simulation has its own seed, which depends only on its parameters and
replicate, so results do not depend on the number of cores. Since #175, results
for a given seed no longer depend on the random number library of the compiler.
Runs made with `run.R` record the command, the platform and the versions of all
packages; the archives with the results per replicate are to be attached to the
GitHub releases. Single changes are attributed with `model-behavior/attribution.R`.
